name: Blade Runner 2049
description: Lonely, melancholic and awestruck. A replicant hunter in a dying future uncovers a secret that makes him wonder if he is more than a machine. Cyberpunk neon noir, rain-soaked megacities, holograms, droning synthesizers, retro-futurism and existential longing for something real.

name: Interstellar
description: Awestruck, emotional and bittersweet. A father leaves his children to cross a wormhole and find a new home for humanity. Epic space odyssey, black holes, time dilation, pipe-organ grandeur, tears across the stars, love and loss on a cosmic scale.

name: Drive
description: Cool, romantic and dangerous. A silent getaway driver falls for his neighbor and is pulled into a heist gone wrong. 80s-inspired neon noir, synthwave, night drives through Los Angeles, scorpion jacket, quiet tenderness and sudden brutality.

name: Lost in Translation
description: Wistful, intimate and gently funny. Two lonely strangers, an aging actor and a young wife, form a fleeting bond in a Tokyo hotel. Jet lag, karaoke nights, neon city lights, shoegaze and dream pop, quiet indie melancholy and unspoken affection.

name: Whiplash
description: Tense, obsessive and exhilarating. A young jazz drummer is pushed to the breaking point by a ruthless teacher. Big band jazz, bleeding hands, frantic drum solos, conservatory rivalry, ambition, humiliation and a furious, triumphant finale.

name: La La Land
description: Romantic, dreamy and bittersweet. An aspiring actress and a jazz pianist fall in love in Los Angeles while chasing their dreams. Old Hollywood musical, tap dancing at sunset, jazz clubs, technicolor nostalgia, starry-eyed hope and the ache of what might have been.

name: Pulp Fiction
description: Cool, irreverent and darkly funny. Hitmen, a boxer and a gangster's wife cross paths in interlocking crime stories. 90s cult classic, surf rock and vintage soul, diner conversations, twist dancing, retro Americana, swagger and sudden violence.

name: Spirited Away
description: Enchanting, nostalgic and tender. A young girl wanders into a world of spirits and must work in a bathhouse to save her parents. Hand-drawn Japanese animation, fairy-tale wonder, gentle piano, childhood courage, homesickness and bittersweet goodbyes.

name: Parasite
description: Sly, tense and bitterly ironic. A poor family cons its way into a wealthy household until a hidden secret turns everything violent. Class satire, dark comedy thriller, modernist mansion and basement, elegant classical strings, unease and simmering rage.

name: Mad Max: Fury Road
description: Furious, wild and exhilarating. Rebels flee a tyrant across a desert wasteland in one long, roaring chase. Post-apocalyptic action, war rigs, flame-throwing guitar, pounding drums, heavy metal energy, chaos, survival and defiance.

name: The Grand Budapest Hotel
description: Whimsical, elegant and nostalgic. A legendary concierge and his lobby boy are swept into a caper over a stolen painting in old Europe. Pastel symmetry, quirky deadpan humor, folk waltzes, vintage charm and a quiet sadness for a vanished world.

name: Eternal Sunshine of the Spotless Mind
description: Heartbroken, dreamlike and tender. A man erases his ex-girlfriend from his memory, then tries to hold on as the memories fade. Indie romance, surreal dream logic, winter beaches, lo-fi quirkiness, regret, awkward love and stubborn hope.

name: Amélie
description: Whimsical, warm and romantic. A shy Parisian waitress secretly improves the lives of the people around her and finds love. French café charm, accordion and piano waltzes, cobbled streets, quirky fairy-tale nostalgia, small joys and daydreams.

name: The Great Beauty
description: Decadent, melancholic and contemplative. An aging writer drifts through Rome's lavish parties and searches for meaning. Italian dolce vita, rooftop raves and sacred choirs, baroque splendor, world-weary irony, nostalgia and awe.

name: Breaking Bad
description: Gritty, tense and darkly thrilling. A mild chemistry teacher with cancer becomes a ruthless drug kingpin. Desert Americana, antihero crime saga, slow-burn suspense, pride and moral decay, dark humor and explosive consequences.

name: Chernobyl
description: Bleak, dreadful and mournful. Scientists and workers sacrifice themselves to contain a nuclear disaster while officials hide the truth. Soviet-era gloom, historical tragedy, droning ambient horror, grief, fear and quiet heroism.

name: Fleabag
description: Witty, chaotic and heartbreaking. A sharp-tongued young woman in London hides grief and guilt behind jokes and bad decisions. British dark comedy, fourth-wall glances, messy love, church choirs, loneliness, self-sabotage and raw vulnerability.

name: Arcane
description: Intense, stylish and tragic. Two sisters end up on opposite sides of a war between a rich city and its undercity. Steampunk animation, video game universe, punk rebellion, anthemic rock and hip-hop, rage, betrayal and heartbreak.

name: Severance
description: Eerie, sterile and suspenseful. Office workers have their memories split between work and home and begin to rebel against their mysterious company. Corporate dystopia, retro-futuristic offices, deadpan absurdity, minimalist piano, paranoia and creeping dread.

name: Succession
description: Cynical, tense and darkly funny. The children of an aging media mogul scheme and betray each other for control of the empire. Billionaire satire, boardroom power games, grand classical piano over hip-hop beats, cold luxury, insecurity and vicious wit.

name: Time
description: Solemn, epic and melancholic. A slow instrumental that builds from quiet piano to an overwhelming orchestral swell. Blockbuster film score, dream-heist thriller, mind-bending science fiction, hours slipping away and a bittersweet release.

name: Weightless
description: Calm, floating and soothing. A slow ambient drift designed to ease anxiety and slow the heartbeat. Meditation and sleep playlists, spa stillness, deep relaxation, zero-gravity serenity.

name: On the Nature of Daylight
description: Mournful, tender and devastating. A slow lament for strings that rises with grief and compassion. Modern classical, tearjerker film scenes, alien-contact drama, loss, memory and quiet catharsis.

name: An Ending (Ascent) - Remastered 2005
description: Serene, luminous and awestruck. A slow, glowing ambient piece that feels like floating above the Earth. Space documentary, moon landing footage, astronauts, cosmic wonder, peaceful farewell and transcendence.

name: Nuvole Bianche
description: Wistful, romantic and yearning. A flowing solo piano piece that builds from a sigh to an emotional rush. Modern classical, Italian minimalism, rainy windows, study playlists, tearful nostalgia and longing.

name: Avril 14th
description: Delicate, innocent and bittersweet. A brief, fragile piano melody like a music box. Electronic pioneer gone acoustic, indie film scenes, sampled in hip-hop, childhood memories, sunlit nostalgia and quiet sadness.

name: Clair de Lune, L. 32
description: Graceful, dreamy and romantic. A slow, shimmering piano classic that ripples like moonlight on water. French impressionism, starry nights, classic romance and heist film endings, hushed wonder and calm.

name: Gymnopédie No. 1
description: Sparse, melancholic and detached. A slow, gently swaying piano piece of elegant solitude. Parisian belle époque, rainy afternoons, art-house films, minimalist calm and wistful loneliness.

name: Comptine d'un autre été, l'après-midi
description: Whimsical, bittersweet and nostalgic. A circling solo piano melody, playful yet wistful. French film soundtrack, Parisian cafés and cobbled streets, quirky fairy-tale romance, daydreams and small private sorrows.

name: One Summer Day
description: Gentle, nostalgic and wide-eyed. A tender piano theme full of childhood wonder and homesickness. Japanese animation soundtrack, spirit worlds, fairy-tale adventure, holiday memories, growing up and bittersweet goodbyes.

name: Nightcall
description: Dark, cool and hypnotic. A slow, heavy electronic pulse with robotic vocals about a late confession. Synthwave, 80s retro-futurism, neon noir, drives through an empty city after dark, getaway cars and mysterious romance.

name: A Real Hero
description: Tender, dreamy and hopeful. A soft, glowing synth-pop song about an ordinary person who does something brave. Synthwave, 80s nostalgia, neon noir romance, sunset drives, quiet devotion and innocence.

name: Blinding Lights
description: Urgent, euphoric and desperate. A fast synth-pop hit about racing through the night toward a lover. 80s revival, neon Las Vegas, viral dance challenge, night drives, glamour, loneliness and reckless longing.

name: Midnight City
description: Euphoric, nostalgic and nocturnal. A soaring synth anthem with a saxophone finale about a metropolis after dark. Indie electronic, 80s dreams, neon skylines, coming-of-age montage, youthful freedom and wonder.

name: Little Dark Age
description: Eerie, sardonic and gothic. A danceable synth-pop song about paranoia and hidden gloom. Gothic new wave, 80s horror vibes, viral internet edits, haunted mansions, black humor and dread.

name: Get Lucky (feat. Pharrell Williams & Nile Rodgers) - Radio Edit
description: Smooth, flirtatious and carefree. A funky disco groove about staying up all night for love and good fortune. Retro 70s disco revival, robot helmets, summer parties, dance floors, effortless cool and joy.

name: Firestarter
description: Menacing, frantic and anarchic. A pounding electronic assault with snarling punk vocals. 90s rave, big beat, British club culture, riots and strobe lights, adrenaline, provocation and chaos.

name: Teardrop
description: Haunting, intimate and hypnotic. A slow heartbeat rhythm under a fragile, ethereal voice. 90s trip-hop, medical drama theme, rainy British nights, dark sensuality, sorrow and tenderness.

name: Glory Box
description: Sultry, smoky and aching. A slow, heavy torch song about a woman tired of playing games and longing to be loved. 90s trip-hop, film noir, spy-movie strings, vinyl crackle, seduction and weariness.

name: Playground Love
description: Hazy, sensual and sorrowful. A slow, velvety song with a saxophone about teenage first romance. French downtempo, 70s suburban nostalgia, indie coming-of-age film soundtrack, doomed crushes and longing.

name: Space Song
description: Dreamy, starry and heartbroken. A slow, shimmering dream pop song about letting go of someone. Indie dream pop, viral melancholy edits, night skies, drifting among the stars, lovesick nostalgia.

name: Apocalypse
description: Languorous, intimate and melancholic. A slow, reverb-soaked whisper about lovers holding on while the world collapses. Dream pop, noir romance, black-and-white aesthetics, late-night bedrooms, devotion and sadness.

name: Fade Into You
description: Woozy, lovelorn and resigned. A slow, dusty waltz about loving someone who never fully sees you. 90s alternative dream pop, slide guitar, teen drama slow dances, late-summer haze, unrequited love.

name: Intro
description: Minimal, tense and anticipatory. A short instrumental build with a cool guitar line and a steady beat. Indie electronic, sports and TV montages, opening credits, city at night, restrained excitement before something begins.

name: Nights
description: Restless, introspective and bittersweet. A shifting R&B song that moves from daytime hustle to a hazy late comedown. Alternative R&B, famous beat switch, sleepless city, memories of struggle, nostalgia and loneliness.

name: Between The Bars
description: Hushed, intimate and fragile. A soft acoustic whisper about drinking to forget and being held back by sadness. 90s indie folk, late-night pubs, indie drama soundtracks, addiction, loneliness and tender resignation.

name: Hallelujah
description: Reverent, sorrowful and yearning. A slow, sparse ballad with a soaring voice about love, faith and heartbreak. 90s alternative rock, cathedral echo, talent-show classic, funerals and farewells, sacred longing and fragile beauty.

name: Skinny Love
description: Raw, wounded and wintry. A bare acoustic plea with a cracked falsetto about a relationship falling apart. Indie folk, snowed-in cabin, heartbreak playlists, isolation, regret and desperation.

name: Pink Moon
description: Gentle, wistful and mysterious. A brief, softly flowing acoustic song with a quiet sense of foreboding. 70s British folk, night drives through the countryside, cult singer-songwriter, pastoral calm and lonely melancholy.

name: Karma Police
description: Weary, uneasy and haunting. A slow piano-led rock song about paranoia and judgment that dissolves into a dazed collapse. 90s alternative rock, dystopian anxiety, alienation, cold irony, a mind quietly coming apart.

name: Take Five
description: Cool, suave and playful. A breezy, swinging jazz instrumental with a famous saxophone line and an unusual rhythm. 50s cool jazz, smoky lounges, cocktail parties, vintage sophistication, relaxed wit and confidence.

name: So What (feat. John Coltrane, Cannonball Adderley & Bill Evans)
description: Laid-back, spacious and contemplative. A mellow, unhurried jazz instrumental with trumpet and saxophone solos. 50s modal jazz, smoky clubs after midnight, black-and-white New York, understated cool.

name: Feeling Good
description: Triumphant, soulful and bold. A slow, brassy anthem about freedom, rebirth and a new dawn. Classic soul and big band jazz, spy-movie swagger, empowerment, luxury adverts, hard-won confidence.

name: My Funny Valentine
description: Tender, melancholy and dreamy. A very slow, soft jazz ballad sung in a fragile voice about loving someone's imperfections. 50s cool jazz, dim bars in the small hours, old Hollywood romance, wistful affection.

name: Son Of A Preacher Man
description: Sultry, warm and nostalgic. A relaxed soul song about a secret first romance with a minister's boy. 60s soul, vintage vinyl, cult crime film soundtrack, retro Americana, sly sweetness and fond memories.

name: Bang Bang (My Baby Shot Me Down)
description: Haunting, sparse and mournful. A slow, eerie ballad with tremolo guitar about childhood love turned to betrayal. 60s pop, revenge film opening, spaghetti western mood, lost innocence, heartbreak and vengeance.

name: September
description: Joyful, bright and irresistible. An upbeat disco-funk classic about remembering a perfect night of dancing and love. 70s disco, wedding parties, horn sections, feel-good nostalgia, celebration and carefree happiness.

name: Uptown Funk (feat. Bruno Mars)
description: Swaggering, flashy and playful. A tight, strutting pop hit full of bragging and party energy. 80s revival, street dancing, wedding dance floors, retro suits, cocky charm and fun.

name: Dancing Queen
description: Euphoric, glittering and bittersweet. A sweeping disco-pop anthem about being young and free on the dance floor. 70s disco, mirror balls, jukebox musical, karaoke nights, nostalgia for a perfect night.

name: Don't Stop Me Now - Remastered 2011
description: Exhilarated, theatrical and unstoppable. A fast, jubilant piano-rock anthem about having the time of your life. 70s glam rock, zombie-comedy pub fight, party playlists, rocket-speed joy and invincible freedom.

name: Here Comes The Sun - Remastered 2009
description: Hopeful, gentle and bright. A light acoustic pop song about the relief of spring after a long winter. 60s British pop, flower-power optimism, family road trips, warmth, comfort and new beginnings.

name: Alors on danse - Radio Edit
description: Jaded, weary and hypnotic. A pulsing club track with deadpan vocals about partying to forget work, money and problems. French-language electro house, 2010s clubs, viral slowed remix, saxophone hook, numb escapism.

name: Killing In The Name
description: Angry, loud and explosive. A heavy rap-metal protest song that builds into a furious chant of defiance. 90s rap metal, protest marches, mosh pits, anti-authority fury, rebellion and adrenaline.

name: Smells Like Teen Spirit
description: Restless, sardonic and cathartic. A quiet-loud grunge anthem of adolescent boredom and frustration. 90s grunge, flannel shirts, high-school gym mosh pit, generation-defining angst, apathy and release.

name: Master Of Puppets
description: Menacing, relentless and intense. A fast, epic thrash metal song about being controlled by addiction. 80s heavy metal, shredding guitar solos, retro horror series finale, headbanging, dark fury and doom.

name: HUMBLE.
description: Confrontational, cocky and stark. A hard, minimal hip-hop track with a pounding piano beat about demanding modesty while flaunting dominance. Modern rap, trap drums, striking music video, street bravado and tension.

name: Beggin'
description: Gritty, desperate and seductive. A stomping rock cover with raspy vocals pleading with a lover for one more chance. Italian glam rock, song-contest winners, viral short videos, 60s soul roots, swagger and urgency.

name: Comfortably Numb
description: Detached, dreamlike and majestic. A slow progressive rock epic about emotional emptiness and isolation with a soaring guitar solo. 70s psychedelic rock, concept album, stadium lights, childhood memories, alienation and anguish.

name: La vie en rose
description: Romantic, lush and old-fashioned. A slow, swooning love song about seeing the world through tinted glasses of happiness. French chanson, Paris postcards, accordion cafés, operatic tenor, vintage romance and bliss.

name: Sweet Dreams (Are Made of This) - Remastered
description: Cold, sleek and ominous. A steady synth-pop classic about everyone searching for something and using each other. 80s new wave, androgynous icon, MTV era, dark dance floors, cynicism and desire.
